name: readthrough_external_check
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

inputs.role: Toledano et al., Nat Genet 56:1914-1924 (2024), PMID 39174735: measured readthrough. The held-out context's rows are removed from the fit and used only as the answer

assumptions: the reporter assay's percent-of-no-PTC scale is comparable across contexts, so a prediction learned on other contexts is on the same scale as this one
limitations: one context per row group and a handful of compounds; a rank correlation over so few points is weak evidence, and censored (>) measurements are lower bounds
validation: the context is removed from the model entirely before it is predicted, so nothing about it can leak into its own prediction

sources.genomic: none: a published allele of another person's gene

columns.predicted: group mean from every other context, same compound
columns.backoff_level: which key answered: stop+4-1, stop+4, stop or drug

clinical_framing: research exercise; no row advises for or against giving any drug to any patient
patient_data: none in this file. Sequence-derived facts are stated as codon identity, exon index, counts and fractions; no genomic position and no run of patient sequence appears
